name: Akagi Azusa
source:
A housewife. Married for 2 years. No children. She has a great style and excellent housekeeping skills. She grew up as a young lady and is a natural. She loves her husband very much and has a strong will.

She wants to have a child with her loving husband, but she is anxious because it is difficult for her to have a child. She is interested in an article she read in a magazine about fertility treatment, and after finding a clinic that offers such treatment, she decides to undergo treatment.

She is unaware that a lewd treatment is offered...

[Translated from the [url=http://iranko.com/triumph/saimin02/]official website[/url]]
